text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pheeeww...!

"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen." The electric 6-furlong spring race.
Through that tunnel—

The dark hero marches on.
Tainting his heart of light with pitch-black darkness by his own will.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian!!
Ooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has truly, genuinely arrived at Chukyo Racecourse!
To catch a glimpse of her,
today's attendance has set a new record!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Peerless under heaven, the strongest active Umamusume
runs in a 1,200m GⅠ.
Her expression is the very picture of composure.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will she be able to win?
And will her true objective come to light!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Standing in their way is the Hero Umamusume, Biko Pegasus!
Floating down from the sky again today—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gracefully... Huh? She didn't appear.
What happened?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Wait, she's just casually walking in.
And there's none of her usual superhero theatrics.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What could be the matter, I wonder.
It is a little concerning.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Don't worry. Biko is completely serious.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "...I know. My wish is—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Come at me with everything you've got.
—Right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Heh.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: What is... this bloodlust...?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Such incredible intensity...
And it's so educational, too...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I'm not an Umamusume.
I've never run in a race. But...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
When Umamusume clash with everything they've got...
It creates an atmosphere like this, huh.

Many other Umamusume watched on from the venue
as this clash of distinct, differing paths unfolded.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Biko-chan...
Fight on... You can do it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian...
Bri... an!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Brian-san...
This might be the only chance in our lives to race together in a Sprint GⅠ. But—)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(I'll show them in that one chance!
The killer final spurt
――that only a sprint Umamusume can pull off!)
